label: Todoist

sensitivePaths.label: Delete a project
sensitivePaths.warning: Every task in it goes with it.

agentGuide: Base path /api/v1; lists come as {results: [], next_cursor}. Projects: GET /api/v1/projects (id, name); sections: GET /api/v1/sections?project_id=<id>. Tasks: GET /api/v1/tasks?project_id=<id> (content, due.date, priority 1-4 where 4 is highest, labels, is_completed); by filter: GET /api/v1/tasks/filter?query=today | overdue (Todoist filter syntax: "today | overdue", "#Work & p1", "7 days"). Add: POST /api/v1/tasks {"content": "...", "due_string": "tomorrow at 9", "project_id": "...", "priority": 3, "description": "..."}; edit: POST /api/v1/tasks/<id> {"content": "..."}; done: POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/close; reopen: POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/reopen. Comments: GET /api/v1/comments?task_id=<id>, add: POST /api/v1/comments {"task_id": "...", "content": "..."}. Labels: GET /api/v1/labels. Completed: GET /api/v1/tasks/completed/by_completion_date?since=<ISO>&until=<ISO>. The token is set by Allkin.
